summary: Iteration 14 — Pre-compiled dashboard.html (removing @babel/standalone runtime) VERIFIED across all 10 review items. window.Babel is undefined on /dashboard.html; no <script src='unpkg.com/@babel/standalone'>, no type='text/babel', no Babel.transformScriptTags() in HTML source; /dashboard.compiled.js served with Content-Type 'application/javascript; charset=UTF-8' at 1,933,667 bytes (~1.88 MB). React tree mounts: 46+ data-testids present (venue-preset-chip, collector-config-btn, standards-btn, reset-modal-sizes-btn, tab-chart/diagnostics/dynamics/weather3d, sweet-spot-range, ahu-drill-AHU-01-E, etc.); SVG psy chart renders; only network/auth (401/404) errors in console — zero JS evaluation/parse errors. Icon-row modals OK: standards-btn opens docs modal; collector-config-btn opens [data-testid='collector-config-modal'] showing AHU groups; gear (button[title='Config']) opens password input; reset-modal-sizes-btn fires feedback. Venue chip default reads 'CUSTOM 40-60%'; after localStorage seed (red5_rh_preset='museum' + sweet_spot_range={lo:40,hi:55}) chip reads 'MUSEUM 40-55%'; chip click → /setup.html?force=1. Givoni active bg=rgb(79,70,229) indigo + color=rgb(15,23,42) dark text ✓; 40-60% RH active bg=rgb(4,120,87) emerald + dark text ✓. VAV TERMINAL HUB header (with HTG indicator, comfort %, A COMFORT / B SOFT TRIM / C+ HOT/HUMID / C- COLD/DRY tier legend) renders on AHU card click — confirmed visually in /tmp/screenshot. View tabs DIAG/DYNAM/3D WX/PSYCH all switch panes via data-testid clicks. End-to-end round-trip: /dashboard.html → chip → /setup.html?force=1 → 'Open Dashboard' → /dashboard.html with localStorage['red5.setup.done']='1'. Build script bash /app/frontend/src/dashboard/build.sh executes with exit 0, produces 1888.3 KB / 1328-line bundle. Re-running yields a functionally equivalent bundle (size + line count identical) but byte-different due to inline source map referencing the per-run mktemp /tmp/tmp.XXX.jsx path — acceptable per the spec ('byte-identical OR functionally equivalent').
action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Build script — to make rebuilds byte-identical, switch from inline source maps + mktemp temp file to either (a) external source map with deterministic root, or (b) pass a fixed-name temp file in /tmp (e.g. /tmp/dashboard_concat.jsx). Currently the source map's 'sources' field includes the per-run /tmp/tmp.XXXXX.jsx path which changes every invocation. Bundle code itself appears stable — only the inline source map base64 differs. Not a functional issue.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.html now loads /dashboard.compiled.js as a single regular <script> — clean replacement of the prior fetch+concat+Babel.transformScriptTags() flow. @babel/standalone CDN line is fully removed (only a 4-line comment remains explaining the rationale, no <script src>).

build.sh keeps file order in sync with dashboard.html lines 468-489 (psychrometric → dashboard-components → schema-config → preview-components → sun-path → 16 dashboard/*.js). The header comment explicitly warns that order matters because top-level const/let are not hoisted — good defensive doc.
babel preset-env + preset-react config produces 1888.3 KB / 1328-line output (under 2 MB threshold) — well within HTTP cache budget.

Existing console errors on /dashboard.html (Failed to fetch /api/weather-location 401, plus four 404s) are pre-existing backend-auth artefacts of the preview environment and NOT regressions of this iteration. They appear identically on the prior runtime-Babel build.

Self-rebuilds yield functionally equivalent bundle (same size, same line count, same module list, same body code) but the inline source-map base64 carries a /tmp/tmp.XXXXX.jsx path that differs per mktemp call → md5 differs. Spec explicitly permits this ('byte-identical OR functionally equivalent') so PASS, but a deterministic build (action item above) would be ideal for CI artefact comparison.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeding inside Playwright session only: red5_sweet_spot_range={"lo":40,"hi":55} and red5_rh_preset='museum' to verify chip preset detection; cleaned up at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 review items verified PASS on https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com/dashboard.html. Key selectors that work: data-testid='venue-preset-chip' (poll wait_for_selector for up to 15s after wait_until='domcontentloaded' — page polls /api/weather-location forever so networkidle never settles); view tab testids are tab-chart / tab-diagnostics / tab-dynamics / tab-weather3d (NOT 'PSYCH'/'DIAG' text exact — CSS uppercase-transform fools text= matchers, real text is title-case 'Psych'/'Diag'/'Dynam'/'3D Wx'); to trigger VAV TERMINAL HUB you must click the AHU card's outer cursor-pointer div, NOT the [data-testid='ahu-drill-AHU-01-E'] (that opens the detail modal). Gear button has no data-testid; locate via button[title='Config']. Console errors of 5-10 are EXPECTED (weather API 401 + 4 missing static assets) — only flag if they are JS parse/evaluation/Babel errors, of which there are zero. Build artefact: bash /app/frontend/src/dashboard/build.sh re-creates /app/frontend/public/dashboard.compiled.js in ~6s (preset-env + preset-react), output is functionally equivalent across runs but inline source map differs.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found. Iteration 14's precompile of dashboard.html is byte-for-byte behaviour-equivalent to the prior runtime-Babel build (same 20 modules in same order, same Babel transforms). The single observed non-determinism (md5 differs between rebuilds) is fully explained by the inline source map containing the per-run mktemp /tmp/tmp.XXX.jsx pathname; the JS body itself is stable. Spec explicitly permits this ('byte-identical OR functionally equivalent').
